about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Grain Bowl
recipes.summary: Grilled chicken, brown rice and cos lettuce tossed in a lemony caesar dressing with croutons.
steps: Cook the rice in plenty of boiling water for 25 minutes until tender, then drain and cool.
Cook the chicken in the oil for 6 minutes each side, until golden and 75°C in the centre, then rest and slice.
Toast the bread cubes in a dry pan for 4 minutes until crisp.
Whisk the mayonnaise, lemon juice, garlic and anchovies, then toss with the rice and lettuce.
Top with the chicken, croutons and cheese.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until 75°C in the thickest part with no pink inside.

recipes.title: Roast Beetroot Salad with Goats Cheese and Walnuts
recipes.summary: Sweet roast beetroot with peppery rocket, creamy goats cheese and toasted walnuts in a mustard vinaigrette.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C, wrap the beetroot in foil with 1 tbsp oil and roast for 45 minutes until a knife slides in.
Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 4 minutes until fragrant.
Peel and wedge the beetroot once cool enough to handle.
Whisk the remaining oil, balsamic, mustard and salt, then toss with the beetroot and rocket.
Top with crumbled goats cheese and walnuts.
notes: Wear gloves when peeling the beetroot to avoid staining.

recipes.title: Italian Chickpea and Tuna Salad with Red Onion
recipes.summary: Quick tinned chickpea and tuna salad with parsley, red onion and lemon.

items: 2 cans tuna in oil (185g each), drained

steps: Soak the onion slices in cold water for 5 minutes, then drain.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice and salt.
Toss the chickpeas, tuna, onion, parsley and tomatoes with the dressing.
Rest for 10 minutes until the flavours meld.
notes: Food safety: keep the salad chilled and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Spanish Ensalada de Garbanzos with Roasted Capsicum
recipes.summary: Chickpeas with roasted capsicum, tomato, cucumber and sherry vinegar dressing.
steps: Whisk the oil, vinegar and paprika.
Toss the chickpeas with the capsicum, tomatoes, cucumber and onion.
Pour over the dressing and fold in the parsley.
Chill for 15 minutes until the flavours soften.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

recipes.title: Spanish Pipirrana Andalusian Summer Salad
recipes.summary: Finely diced tomato, cucumber and capsicum in a sherry vinegar dressing, often served with seafood.
steps: Combine the tomatoes, cucumber, capsicum, onion and parsley in a bowl.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and salt and pour over.
Toss and rest for 10 minutes until juicy.
Serve cold with bread to mop up the juices.
notes: Peel the cucumber if the skin is thick.

recipes.title: Spanish Sopa de Ajo Castilian Garlic Soup
recipes.summary: Garlic and paprika soup with stale bread and a poached egg dropped in at the end.
steps: Fry the garlic in the oil for 2 minutes until golden, then add the bread for 3 minutes until crisp.
Stir in the paprika for 20 seconds, then pour in the stock.
Simmer for 15 minutes until the bread is soft and thick.
Crack in the eggs and poach for 4 minutes until the whites are set.
notes: Food safety: cook until the egg whites are fully set; cook the yolks through for anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Spanish Salmorejo Cordoba Tomato and Bread Soup
recipes.summary: Thick chilled tomato and bread soup, finished with olive oil, egg and ham.
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until firm, then cool and chop.
Blend the tomatoes, bread, garlic, vinegar and salt until completely smooth.
Blend in the oil slowly until the soup is thick and pale orange.
Chill for 1 hour, then top with egg and ham.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until fully set; keep the soup cold and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Portuguese Sopa de Feijao Bean and Cabbage Soup
recipes.summary: Hearty bean, carrot and cabbage soup with garlic and olive oil, finished with a splash of vinegar.
steps: Cook the onion, carrots and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the beans, stock and bay leaf and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the cabbage and simmer for 6 minutes until tender.
Stir in the vinegar and salt and remove the bay leaf.
notes: Mash a ladle of beans against the pot to thicken the soup.

recipes.title: French Soupe a l'Oignon Gratinee Onion Soup with Cheese Toast
recipes.summary: Deeply caramelised onions in beef stock topped with toasted bread and melted cheese.
steps: Cook the onions in the butter and oil over low heat for 40 minutes, stirring often, until deep brown and jammy.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, pour in the wine and let it bubble for 3 minutes.
Add the stock and thyme and simmer for 15 minutes.
Top the baguette with the cheese and grill for 3 minutes until melted and bubbling.
Ladle the soup into bowls and float a toast on top while the cheese is still bubbling.
notes: Cook the onions slowly; rushing them leaves a bitter taste.

recipes.title: French Soupe au Pistou Vegetable Soup with Basil Paste
recipes.summary: Summer vegetable and white bean soup stirred with a garlicky basil pistou.
steps: Simmer the onion, potatoes, carrots and water for 15 minutes.
Add the green beans, zucchini and white beans and cook for 10 minutes more.
Add the pasta and cook for 8 minutes until al dente.
Crush the basil, garlic, oil and cheese to a green paste.
Stir the pistou into the soup off the heat and serve.
notes: Do not boil the soup after adding the pistou or the basil turns dark.

recipes.title: French Salade de Lentilles du Puy with Mustard Vinaigrette
recipes.summary: Green lentils tossed warm with shallot, carrot, parsley and mustard vinaigrette.
steps: Simmer the lentils with the bay leaf in plenty of water for 22 minutes until tender but whole.
Drain and discard the bay leaf.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard and salt.
Toss the warm lentils with the carrot, shallot, parsley and dressing.
notes: Better the next day once the lentils absorb the dressing.

recipes.title: French Crepes Bretonnes Buckwheat Galettes with Ham and Egg
recipes.summary: Savoury buckwheat crepes folded around ham, cheese and a baked egg.
steps: Whisk the buckwheat flour, salt, 1 egg and water to a thin batter and rest for 15 minutes.
Cook thin crepes in buttered pan for 2 minutes each side until crisp at the edges.
Add ham, cheese and an egg to the centre of each crepe and cook for 4 minutes until the white is set.
Fold the edges in to make a square and serve.
notes: Food safety: cook until the egg whites are fully set; cook the yolks through for anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Swiss Birchermuesli Overnight Apple Oats
recipes.summary: Rolled oats soaked in milk and yoghurt with grated apple, honey and nuts.
steps: Mix the oats, milk, yoghurt and lemon juice in a bowl.
Cover and soak in the fridge overnight until creamy.
Stir through the grated apple, honey and raisins.
Top with the chopped hazelnuts and serve.
notes: Keeps for 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: German Kaiserschmarrn Torn Pancake with Apple Compote
recipes.summary: A fluffy thick pancake torn into pieces and caramelised, served with fruit.
steps: Whisk the flour, milk, yolks, sugar and salt into a smooth batter, then fold in whipped egg whites.
Melt half the butter in a large pan, pour in the batter, scatter with raisins and cook for 5 minutes until golden underneath.
Flip, tear into pieces with two forks and fry for 4 minutes with the remaining butter until caramelised.
Simmer the apples with a splash of water for 5 minutes until soft and serve with the pancake dusted with icing sugar.
notes: Food safety: cook the batter until the egg is fully set.

recipes.title: Slovak Halusky with Cabbage and Bacon
recipes.summary: Soft grated potato dumplings tossed with fried cabbage and crisp bacon.
steps: Finely grate the potatoes and mix with the flour, egg and salt to a sticky dough.
Drop small pieces into boiling salted water and cook for 3 minutes until they float.
Fry the bacon for 5 minutes until crisp, then cook the onion and cabbage in the fat and oil for 8 minutes until soft and golden.
Toss the dumplings through and serve hot.
notes: Food safety: cook the bacon until crisp and the dumpling dough until firm all the way through.

recipes.title: Finnish Karjalanpiirakka Karelian Rice Pies
recipes.summary: Thin rye shells filled with creamy rice porridge, baked and brushed with butter, topped with egg butter.
steps: Simmer the rice with the milk and 200ml water for 25 minutes, stirring, until a thick porridge.
Knead the flours, salt and 120ml water to a dough, divide into 8, and roll each thin.
Spoon porridge into the centre of each, pinch the edges and bake at 250°C for 12 minutes until the crust is golden.
Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, chop and mix with the soft butter.
Brush the pies with melted butter and top with egg butter.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until fully set.

recipes.title: Chinese Spring Onion Pancakes
recipes.summary: Flaky layered pancakes with spring onions and sesame oil, pan-fried until crisp.
steps: Mix the flour and hot water to a dough and knead for 5 minutes, then rest for 30 minutes.
Divide into 4, roll thin, brush with sesame oil and salt, scatter with spring onion, roll into a log and coil.
Flatten and roll to 1 cm thick and fry in oil for 3 minutes each side until golden and crisp.
Mix the soy sauce and vinegar for dipping.
notes: Press the pancake lightly while frying so the layers separate.

recipes.title: Chinese Wonton Soup in Clear Chicken Broth
recipes.summary: Silky pork and prawn wontons in a clear ginger broth with bok choy.
steps: Mix the pork, prawns, soy sauce, sesame oil and grated ginger.
Place a teaspoon of filling in each wrapper and fold into a parcel.
Simmer the stock and sliced ginger for 5 minutes.
Add the wontons and cook for 4 minutes until they float and the filling reaches 75°C.
Add the bok choy for 1 minute and serve with spring onions.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork and prawn filling until 75°C and the prawns are opaque; chill leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Chinese Black Vinegar Dumpling Dipping Sauce
recipes.summary: Sharp, salty dipping sauce of Chinkiang vinegar, soy and fresh ginger.
steps: Stir the vinegar, soy sauce and sugar until the sugar dissolves.
Add the sesame oil, ginger, garlic and chilli oil.
Rest for 5 minutes so the garlic mellows.
Serve in small dishes for dumplings.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 5 days.

recipes.title: Chinese Sesame Noodle Salad with Cucumber
recipes.summary: Cold wheat noodles in a creamy sesame and soy dressing with crisp cucumber and carrot.
steps: Boil the noodles for 5 minutes until tender, then rinse in cold water and drain.
Whisk the tahini, soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, sugar and garlic with 3 tbsp warm water until smooth.
Toss the noodles with the dressing, cucumber and carrot.
Scatter with sesame seeds.
notes: Serve with chilli oil for extra heat.

recipes.title: Japanese Potato Salad with Cucumber and Ham
recipes.summary: Creamy mashed potato salad with cucumber, carrot and ham in a Japanese-style mayonnaise.
steps: Boil the potatoes and carrot for 15 minutes until soft, adding the eggs for the last 10 minutes.
Salt the cucumber and squeeze out the liquid after 10 minutes.
Drain the potatoes, mash roughly, and cool.
Mix with the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, ham, cucumber and chopped eggs.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until fully set and keep the salad chilled, eating within 2 days.

recipes.title: Japanese Tonkatsu Sauce Sweet Fruity Cutlet Sauce
recipes.summary: Thick, sweet and tangy sauce for crumbed cutlets and cabbage.
steps: Whisk the tomato sauce, Worcestershire sauce, soy sauce, sugar, apple juice and mustard in a small pot.
Simmer for 3 minutes until slightly thickened and glossy.
Cool and pour into a jar.
Serve with fried pork cutlets or shredded cabbage.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Korean Tteokguk New Year Rice Cake Soup
recipes.summary: Beef broth with sliced rice cakes and egg ribbons, eaten on Lunar New Year.
steps: Fry the beef in the sesame oil for 4 minutes, add the garlic and 1 tbsp soy sauce, then pour in the water.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the beef is tender.
Add the rice cakes and cook for 6 minutes until soft and floating.
Stream in the eggs and stir for 1 minute until set in ribbons.
Season with the remaining soy sauce and top with spring onions and nori.
notes: Food safety: simmer the beef until 71°C throughout and the egg is fully set.

recipes.title: Indonesian Sambal Kecap Sweet Soy Chilli Sauce
recipes.summary: Sweet soy sauce with fresh chilli, shallot and lime, a table sauce for satay and grilled food.
steps: Fry the shallots, garlic and chillies in the oil for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Remove from the heat and stir in the sweet soy sauce and lime juice.
Rest for 5 minutes so the flavours blend.
Serve in a bowl with satay, grilled meat or eggs.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 1 week.

recipes.title: Thai Jok Pork and Ginger Rice Porridge
recipes.summary: Silky rice porridge with pork meatballs, ginger and a soft egg, a Bangkok breakfast.
steps: Simmer the rice in the stock for 25 minutes, stirring, until broken and creamy.
Mix the pork with the soy sauce and pepper and roll into small balls.
Drop the meatballs into the porridge and simmer for 6 minutes until cooked through at 75°C.
Crack in the eggs and stir through for 2 minutes until set.
Top with ginger, spring onions and coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until 75°C and the eggs until fully set.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Pol Sambol Coconut Relish
recipes.summary: Spicy dry coconut, chilli and lime relish eaten with hoppers and rice.
steps: Soak the coconut in the warm water for 5 minutes until just moist.
Mix with the shallots, chillies, chilli flakes and salt.
Add the lime juice and crush with clean fingers for 2 minutes until the colour is even.
Serve with breads or rice.
notes: Best eaten the day it is made.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Kiribath Coconut Milk Rice Cake
recipes.summary: Creamy coconut milk rice pressed into diamonds, served with sambol.
steps: Simmer the rice with the water and salt for 15 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Stir in the coconut milk and cook for 10 minutes more, stirring, until thick and sticky.
Press into a greased dish, 3 cm thick, and cool for 10 minutes.
Cut into diamonds and serve with a spicy sambol.
notes: Serve with the pol sambol for a classic breakfast.

recipes.title: Nepali Aloo Achar Spiced Potato Salad with Sesame
recipes.summary: Warm boiled potato with toasted sesame, lemon, chilli and mustard oil style dressing.
steps: Toast the sesame seeds in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden, then grind coarsely.
Heat the oil and fry the cumin for 30 seconds until sizzling, then add the turmeric and chilli.
Pour over the potato with the sesame, lemon juice and salt.
Toss and scatter with coriander.
notes: Serve warm or at room temperature.
